data.name: root
data.value: Your repositories as one workspace: for people, for CI and for agents.

data.name: option.root
data.value: Folder to act on (the current one by default).

data.name: option.output
data.value: human (by default); json, a document; ndjson, events and then the document. Stable, always in English.

data.name: option.non-interactive
data.value: No questions and no live progress, whatever the terminal (for scripts and CI).

data.name: option.workspace
data.value: Act on the whole workspace, from anywhere inside it.

data.name: option.lang
data.value: Language of the messages: en or es (by default, FX_LANG or the system's).

data.name: sync
data.value: Generate and update what fx owns here and in everything mounted below, from the _fx configuration.

data.name: sync.dry-run
data.value: Show what would change, without writing.

data.name: sync.offline
data.value: No network: do not fetch the repositories.

data.name: sync.adopt
data.value: Take over files written by hand (without the GENERATED header).

data.name: doctor
data.value: Check, without changing anything, that what fx owns here and below is right.

data.name: doctor.offline
data.value: No network: do not ask the remotes.

data.name: module
data.value: Only this module: workspace or dotnet.

data.name: repo.list
data.value: The repositories of the manifest: mount point, policy and whether they are mounted.

data.name: repo.status
data.value: The mounted repositories that ask for attention: branch, commits ahead and behind, changes.

data.name: repo.status.all
data.value: Also the repositories that are clean and up to date.

data.name: repo.some-clean
data.value: {0} of {1} repositories are clean (--all to see them).

data.name: repo.mount
data.value: Mount repositories: fx sync clones what is missing.

data.name: repo.unmount
data.value: Unmount repositories: fx stops managing them; nothing is deleted.

data.name: repo.pull
data.value: Fast-forward the mounted repositories that have a clean working tree.

data.name: repo.mounted
data.value: Mounted: {0}. Run fx sync to clone what is missing.

data.name: version
data.value: The version this repository would build now, from its git history.

data.name: version.explain
data.value: Show how the version was calculated.

data.name: version.branch-commits
data.value: {0} commits since main was last merged

data.name: version.rule.feature
data.value: X.Y.{tag → merge base}-feature.{name}.{commits since main was last merged}

data.name: version.tag
data.value: Create the tag version/X.Y.0 on HEAD to start a new minor or major (local; push it yourself).

data.name: version.tag.argument
data.value: The new major and minor, like 11.3.

data.name: version.tag.created
data.value: Created {0} on {1}. It is local: git push origin {0}

data.name: help.more
data.value: fx <command> --help: the detail of a command.

data.name: repo.nothing-to-mount
data.value: Every repository of the manifest is already mounted.

data.name: repo.nothing-to-unmount
data.value: No mounted repository can be unmounted: the mandatory ones cannot.

data.name: usage.help
data.value: fx --help lists the commands; fx <command> --help explains one.

data.name: usage.missing
data.value: Missing {0}, and there is no terminal to ask for it:

data.name: repo.add
data.value: Add a repository to the manifest, mounted where you say; its name comes from the URL unless --name. Nothing is cloned.

data.name: repo.add.url
data.value: The URL to clone it from.

data.name: repo.add.name
data.value: Its name (by default, from the URL: Fuxion-docs.git → fuxion-docs).

data.name: repo.add.path
data.value: Where it is mounted, relative to the workspace: the layout is yours.

data.name: repo.add.mandatory
data.value: Always mounted (by default, only when someone mounts it).

data.name: repo.remove
data.value: Take a repository out of the manifest; its clone stays.

data.name: repo.tag
data.value: Add tags to a repository, or remove them (--remove).

data.name: repo.tag.remove
data.value: Remove the tags instead of adding them.

data.name: repo.set
data.value: Change a key of a repository: url, path, mount, standalone, dependsOn, solution or solutionExclude.

data.name: repo.set.values
data.value: Its value (several, for dependsOn and solutionExclude).

data.name: modules
data.value: The modules of fx in this root: a folder of _fx each.

data.name: module.enable
data.value: Enable a module: create its folder in _fx, or take out its enabled: false.

data.name: module.disable
data.value: Turn a module off without losing its configuration (enabled: false).

data.name: module.tag
data.value: The tags of the repositories it goes down to (its applies-to).

data.name: manifest.dry-run-option
data.value: Show the change, without writing it.

data.name: repo.ask.tags-add
data.value: Tags to add, separated by spaces

data.name: repo.ask.path
data.value: Folder to mount it in, relative to the workspace

data.name: repo.add.guest
data.value: A guest: the workspace uses it, but it inherits from its own parent (inherits: false).

data.name: path
data.value: What the git of the workspace versions (paths: of the manifest).

data.name: path.add
data.value: Version a file or a folder (ending in /) of the workspace; nothing is created.

data.name: path.remove
data.value: Stop versioning a path; nothing is deleted.

data.name: path.name
data.value: The path, relative to the workspace (a folder ends in /).

data.name: path.exclude
data.value: An exception inside something versioned (exclude: true).

data.name: path.no-worktree
data.value: Left out of the worktrees of the workspace (worktree: false).

data.name: sync.only
data.value: Only this root, not what is mounted below it (nor the map of FxReference).

data.name: sync.parent-ref
data.value: Read the parent from its remote, on this branch (to try what it gives, without versioning the choice).

data.name: repo.rename
data.value: Rename a repository: its references in this workspace change, and the old name stays in aliases.
